takeaways: Moneylines reached 90.5% on unseen seasons, but only on ~25 heavy favorites a season; after the vig they are about break-even.
Over/unders show a small edge (52.8%) and cannot be pushed toward 90%.
The weighted stat formula was the strongest single expert; the consensus is best calibrated.
About 6 certified moneylines a season at ~90%; most weeks have none.
Totals sat at a coin flip at every edge level, so the bot does not play NFL over/unders.
Weather and rest features did not improve totals.
Certified moneylines landed between 83% and 88% depending on the seasons tested; small samples.
No free historical totals exist, so over/unders are not played.
Baseball tops out near 77% even on the most confident picks; 90% is not reachable.
